query: UPDATE import_run SET state = 'failed', settled_at = now(), failure_detail = $3, reason_code = 'activation_expired', reason = $3, reported_stage = 'failed' WHERE org_id = $1 AND state = 'reading' AND NOT scheduled AND attempt = 0 AND created_at <= now() - make_interval(secs => $2) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM import_run_item item WHERE item.org_id = import_run.org_id AND item.run_id = import_run.id AND item.state <> 'listed' ) RETURNING id
